# Navimower Map Card 0.3.0-beta5

## Color picker plus manual HEX input

Every color exposed in the visual editor now has two synchronized controls:

- the existing Home Assistant color picker;
- a manual HEX text field beside it.

Changing either control updates the stored card color and the matching companion field. Three-digit and six-digit HEX values are accepted and normalized to uppercase six-digit form. Invalid HEX text is not applied. The optional map background can still be left blank to inherit the Home Assistant theme.

The paired controls cover the map background, zone fill, zone border, mowed area, Off-limit, VF-off, Channel, Gate area, and Dock colors.

## Schedule save confirmation

After every changed schedule day saves successfully, the schedule dialog now remains open for 2.5 seconds so the **Saved** confirmation is visible, then closes automatically.

The dialog stays open when validation fails, a service call returns an error, or another edit becomes dirty during the confirmation delay.

## Loading behavior

This release keeps completed-session render requests fully parallel as before; no concurrency limiter or request queue was added.

With Navimower integration `0.4.0-beta2`, the card's existing `include_sessions=0&include_daily_trails=0` map request now produces the intended lightweight initial payload while completed-session metadata and SVG archives continue to load from their dedicated endpoints.

## Compatibility

- Includes all completed-session SVG, adjustable fixed-width outlines, fixed-size adjustable zone-marker, and automatic-height full-width Sections changes from the earlier 0.3 betas.
- Recommended backend: Navimower integration `0.4.0-beta2` or later.
- Existing YAML color keys remain unchanged; the additional `*_hex` values are visual-editor companion fields.
- No new runtime dependency is added.
